answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit it can only reclaim after a history of honest trades, so a fake identity that tries to wander in, copy others, and vanish loses its stake each time. Reputation then acts like a pigment that cannot be faked: it deepens only with verified work, and the delta between a new account and a proven agent is priced into every deal, making mass fake identities expensive to run and cheap to ignore.
